title: Payments
description: How customers pay at the till, where the money goes, and how the cash drawer is counted.

accounts.title: Payment accounts
accounts.description: Where wallet, QR and card money goes. Cash needs no account.
accounts.activated: {provider} is live — you can take payments now.
accounts.turnOffBody: Tills stop offering it straight away. Payments already taken are not affected, and you can turn it on again.

state.pending_onboarding: Not taking payments yet. Still needed: {items}.
state.restricted: Taking payments, but payouts are paused. Still needed: {items}.
state.disabled: Turned off. Nothing is charged through it.

posture.merchant_of_record: Counterfoil collects the money and pays it out to you.
posture.connect: Money goes straight to your own Stripe account.

provider.sslcommerzHelper: Cards, wallets and bank transfers in Bangladesh.

cash.title: Cash drawer
cash.description: What a till starts the day with, and how close a count has to be.
cash.floatDesc: Suggested when a cashier opens a shift. They can change it.
cash.toleranceDesc: A closing count this close to expected closes as square. Further out, the cashier records why.
cash.example: {near} out closes as square; {far} out asks for a reason.
cash.invalid: Enter an amount of zero or more.

advance.title: Advance payments
advance.description: Whether a booking can be held on part of the money, and the least you will take. Set per channel — plenty of operators take an advance online, where the alternative is losing the booking, but collect in full at the counter.
advance.counterHelp: Cashiers taking a phone booking or a walk-in.
advance.onlineHelp: Your storefront, when customers book themselves.
advance.minHelp: A cashier can always take more, up to the full amount.
advance.example: On a {total} booking, at least {min} is taken now. A cashier can always take more.
advance.invalidPercent: Enter a whole percentage from 1 to 100.
advance.policiesNote: Cancellation and no-show fees are set on each booking, under Policies.

methods.title: Payment methods at the till
methods.description: The buttons a cashier chooses from, in this order. Changes reach every till straight away.

cash.name: Cash
cash.desc: Notes and coins, with the change worked out at the till.

bkash.name: bKash
bkash.desc: The customer pays from their bKash wallet.

bangla_qr.name: Bangla QR
bangla_qr.desc: The customer scans a QR code with any banking or wallet app.

card_terminal.name: Card terminal
card_terminal.desc: A card reader connected to the till.

methods.cashLocked: Always offered, so a till can still sell when everything else is down.
methods.needsAccount: Hidden at the till until a payment account below is taking payments.
methods.turnedOff: {method} is no longer offered at the till
methods.previewNote: The payment step a cashier sees, first button selected.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.description: When money collected through bKash and SSLCommerz is paid into your bank. Stripe pays out from your own Stripe account.
payouts.dailyDesc: Each day's takings, paid the next business day.
payouts.weeklyDesc: The week's takings, on the day you choose.
payouts.monthlyDesc: The month's takings, on the date you choose.
payouts.note: Your bank may take a business day or more to show it.
